recommendations.name: Symrise AG
recommendations.thesis: Symrise makes natural terpene ingredients used in food and beverages worldwide. Despite selling its US unit, it still supplies key terpene flavors to European and Asian markets. Its 15.8% operating margin shows strong profitability, making it a low‑risk, long‑term play.

exit_conditions.condition: Symrise announces a divestiture of its remaining terpene assets
